title: Boundary metrics measure boundary-count equality, not boundary positions
claim: Segmentation boundary precision/recall/F1/displacement are computed from boundary counts: precision=min(count,expected)/count and displacement=|count-expected|. Reviewed boundary coordinates are never positionally compared.
risk: A candidate with N wrongly placed boundaries reports precision/recall/F1=1 and displacement=0. Metric names misrepresent quality and cannot falsify misplaced segmentation.

evidence.note: Boundary precision/recall/F1/displacement use only boundary_count vs expected_boundaries.
expected_boundaries itself is a declared counter, not compared coordinates.

remediation.objective: Separate count agreement from positional boundary quality and enforce real boundary matching. denying Unknown/native claims or closing milestones.
steps: Rename existing count ratios to count_agreement and the absolute difference to count_difference.
Add positional boundary matching with a documented distance tolerance on canonical ordinal/page coordinates.
Report positional precision/recall/F1 plus true displacement on matched pairs only.
Require unmatched predictions as false positives and unmatched reviewed boundaries as false negatives.
acceptance_criteria: Boundary metric names no longer claim positional quality they do not measure.
A permuted-boundary negative fixture fails the positional metric while count agreement stays 1.
Boundary displacement is zero only for matched boundaries, never for equal counts.

verification.expected: Permuted boundaries fail positional precision; count agreement stays 1.
DATA rule asserts positional boundary contract and fixtures.

assessment.note: Verified in current source: JSON output shows boundary_precision=min(count,expected)/count and displacement=abs(count-expected).

No deployment narrative implies untested database access.

title: Visual real-runner discards successfully extracted donor primitives
claim: observation_for constructs NativeVisualObservation with primitives/captions/callouts/cells/labels all empty on both Ok and Err paths. Successful LayoutShadowObservation fields other than absence and provider identity are not mapped. Malformed donor output maps to NotObserved, conflating processing failure with absence.
risk: A real PDF with figures can report terminal absence while the detector was never given donor content; positive visual capability stays unproven and terminal-only evidence looks like parity.

evidence.note: Ok and Err branches both emit primitives: Vec::new() and all empty visual fields.
Malformed maps to NotObserved; provider/absence only survive the Ok branch.

remediation.objective: Preserve donor observation content through the native visual adapter and stop conflating malformed input with absence. denying Unknown/native claims or closing milestones.
steps: Add an explicit donor-to-native visual converter preserving primitives, provenance, captions, callouts, cells and labels.
Use empty input only when lane_absence is genuinely present.
Map Malformed to a typed representation error, never NotObserved.
Add real positive fixtures: figure+caption, table, formula, ambiguous callout.
Add an input-sensitivity test proving real donor content changes detector outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Real donor primitives reach the native detector when extraction succeeds.
Malformed input cannot report NotObserved.
Positive fixtures prove nonempty observations and falsify terminal-only parity.

verification.expected: Real positive fixtures emit nonempty observations; malformed stays typed error.
Adapter mapping and input-sensitivity tests PASS.

assessment.note: Verified in current source lines 308-364: both branches emit empty vectors; Ok branch preserves only absence/provider.

title: Oracle/model license provenance has unverified items before redistribution
claim: Baseline grobid_compatibility.yaml pins Apache-2.0 for java-grobid-http, but layout/model/training assets outside that baseline lack machine-readable per-component license/provenance/redistribution handling. pdfalto upstream states GPLv2; local /root/vendor-source/pdfalto/LICENSE is GPLv2. GROBID Java is locally Apache-2.0. Unverified redistribution obligations remain for models/training/license texts.
risk: Teams may redistribute weights, binaries, or corpora under the wrong license, omit mandatory notices/source offers, or couple GPL code through future linking/packaging changes. The risk persists while redistribution is unresolved.

evidence.note: Local license text is GPLv2 (June 1991).
Local license text is Apache-2.0.
License field covers java-grobid-http@0.9.0-crf, not per-component layout donor/model provenance.

remediation.objective: Establish component-level license/provenance/redistribution evidence for parse-plane donors, models, weights and corpora; prohibit silent redistribution assumptions. denying Unknown/native claims or closing milestones.
steps: Inventory every layout donor/model/weight/corpus component with upstream source, license text, modifications and redistribution status.
Record process/link/distribution boundaries per component (subprocess vs link vs HTTP).
Require attribution/notice/source-offer artifacts where applicable.
Add governor negatives covering forbidden linking/packaging and missing license evidence.
Record unverified redistribution items as typed blocked, not assumed compatible.
acceptance_criteria: No redistribution path relies on an unverified license assumption.
pdfalto/GROBID/model/data rights are separately evidenced and machine-checkable.
Forbidden coupling has negative tests.

verification.expected: Per-component licenses and redistribution handling are pinned.

assessment.note: Local license files verified; no legal violation asserted. Redistribution/model/license unknowns remain open.

title: P9 runtime stamp carries a historic conserved verdict while reporting not computed
claim: stamp_p9_conservation_observe emits tracked_verdict=conserved while engine_called=false and computed_this_run=false. The flags are honest, but the object combines a historic verdict with a current-run stamp.
risk: Downstream aggregation can count a not-computed verdict as successful current-document conservation.

evidence.note: Historic conserved verdict is emitted with engine_called=false and computed_this_run=false.

remediation.objective: Separate historic conservation evidence from current-run conservation measurement. denying Unknown/native claims or closing milestones.
steps: Represent current-run conservation as NotEvaluated unless measured in that run.
Reference historic evidence by artifact identity and digest, not by inheriting its verdict.
Normalize stamp vocabularies so historical and measured verdicts cannot merge silently.
acceptance_criteria: No current-run report claims conservation it did not compute.
Historic evidence stays traceable without becoming a current verdict.

verification.expected: Not-computed current run cannot emit conserved.
DATA rule distinguishes historic vs measured conservation.

title: Synthetic shadow executions share report space with corpus denominators
claim: Several M501 shadow reports execute on small hand-constructed inputs while publishing large corpus identity numbers such as 3 documents, 202 pages, 606 receipts or 54 cells in the same evidence object. Synthetic unit behavior and corpus scale can be confused.
risk: Readers, agents or future milestones may treat fixture behavior as corpus execution, corpus parity, or evaluated quality.

evidence.note: Hand-injected role hints and small synthetic text execution.
Hand-built markers/targets and dictionary self-matching behavior.
Hand-assembled accounting with fixture-derived unpooled cells.
Two-word documents with terminal receipts beside headline conservation numbers.

remediation.objective: Separate reference-population identity from executed and evaluated populations in every shadow report. denying Unknown/native claims or closing milestones.
steps: Split reports into reference_population, executed_population, evaluated_population, outcomes and quality.
Forbid corpus denominators in reports whose execution did not touch that corpus.
Permit terminal-only runs to claim accounting_contour only, never parity/metric.
acceptance_criteria: No shadow report lets synthetic execution inherit corpus scale.
Parity/metric claims require matching executed and evaluated populations.

verification.expected: Schema validation rejects mixed-population parity claims.
Corpus numbers require corpus execution evidence.

assessment.note: Pattern-level finding across M501 shadow examples; per-report T01 verification precedes milestone closure.

title: ReviewReady is unreachable in the maturity derivation despite ladder order
claim: MaturityState enumerates InventoryBound through HumanGateRequired with ReviewReady before HumanGateRequired. The full-receipt derivation branch returns HumanGateRequired immediately, so no receipt set derives ReviewReady. ReviewReady remains nominally claimable elsewhere, while HumanGateRequired means awaiting human action, not granted authorization.
risk: Consumers can mistake immediate HumanGateRequired for completed review or mistake awaiting-action for authorization; there is no explicit Pending stage for human work in progress.

evidence.note: Enum places ReviewReady before HumanGateRequired.
Full receipt set returns HumanGateRequired directly; ReviewReady is not derived.

remediation.objective: Model review readiness and human authorization as separate machine-checked dimensions. denying Unknown/native claims or closing milestones.
steps: Keep evidence completeness separate from human authorization.
Derive ReviewReady when all required receipts/validations are present.
Represent awaiting-human as an explicit Pending authorization state.
Forbid ReviewReady+Pending from authorizing production/import behavior.
Document that HumanGateRequired means required, not granted.
acceptance_criteria: ReviewReady is derivable from complete evidence.
Pending human work is explicit and distinct from authorization.
No M500 or PIR-015 consumer treats awaiting-action as permission.

verification.expected: Full evidence derives ReviewReady; human gate remains Pending until explicit approval.

assessment.note: Verified in current source: 452-459 derive HumanGateRequired on len==ALL. No authorization splice proposed.

title: Promotion dry run proves completeness better than evidentiary sufficiency
claim: derive_promotion_gate performs extensive form/integrity checks, but validation_gap comes from candidate metadata, unknown contamination is represented as false, producer independence is only weakly checked, and the gate has no numeric quality thresholds. Seven proof slots can share one evaluation digest under different names.
risk: A mechanically complete review package can look promotion-ready while quality, independence, contamination and validation separation remain unproven.

evidence.note: Form/integrity/slot checks precede HumanGateRequired; quality policy/value checks are absent.
Report carries candidate validation_gap, contamination_detected=false, producer_independent=true.

remediation.objective: Keep review-package completeness separate from technical promotion qualification. denying Unknown/native claims or closing milestones.
steps: Keep completeness checking as one function.
Compute quality policy from measured values with explicit thresholds.
Bind validation_gap to explicit train/validation separation.
Represent unknown contamination as NotAssessed, not false.
Check producer provenance, not only string identity.
Disentangle shared-digest slots or explicitly model shared failure modes.
acceptance_criteria: Complete packages are not mistaken for qualified promotions.
Quality/independence/contamination checks have explicit values and thresholds.

verification.expected: Shared digest, weak independence and unknown contamination cannot pass as qualified.

assessment.note: Verified in current source; nine-run independence is not required. Shared sources need explicit failure-mode modeling.

title: Freshness identity and revision selection are not bound into evidence receipts
claim: Evidence sets identify paper_id/source digests but do not carry a complete machine-checked freshness identity: target revision, observed revision, source bytes, parser/config identity, cache key and observation time. TEI-declared revision remains single-source declared evidence under ADR-065 and may later need cross-checking.
risk: Stale, superseded or mismatched inputs can satisfy source-equality checks without proving they are the intended current revision.

evidence.note: Evidence identity centers on paper/source digests, not complete freshness identity.
TEI-declared revision is single-source declared evidence.
Revision/manifestation model exists separately from evidence receipts.

remediation.objective: Bind explicit revision/freshness identity into evidence and keep declared revision trust explicit. denying Unknown/native claims or closing milestones.
steps: Add a bounded freshness identity: target revision, observed revision, source/representation digests, parser/config identity, cache key, observed time.
Derive stale/superseded outcomes by comparing receipts against the selected target revision.
Keep TEI-declared revision as single-source trust with explicit deferred cross-check receipts.
Forbid source-digest equality alone from proving currentness.
acceptance_criteria: Stale/superseded evidence cannot pass as current.
Declared revision trust is explicit and later cross-checkable.

verification.expected: Superseded inputs fail freshness checks despite digest equality.

assessment.note: No wall-clock freshness oracle is required; ordering/selection/digest binding is the correction.

title: Meta-prompt normatives lack a machine-checkable authority and change-control model
claim: Baseline/system prompt duplication exists and normative MUST/SHOULD language is sparse and prose-local. Prompt/meta-prompt rules lack identifiers, scope, authority, preconditions, evidence obligations, exceptions and expiry. Verification commands are represented as strings or prose rather than approved operation identifiers.
risk: Optimizers, agents or future edits can erase proof obligations, promotion boundaries, evidence standards or safety locks. Natural-language warnings are not machine-enforced contracts.

evidence.note: 498 bytes; byte-identical to summarizer system prompt.
498 bytes; byte-identical to article-summary baseline.
NEVER guess is prose, not a checkable normative level.

remediation.objective: Give prompt/meta-prompt normatives identifiers, authority hierarchy, evidence obligations and optimizer-immutable proof boundaries. denying Unknown/native claims or closing milestones.
steps: Deduplicate prompt sources or explicitly mark one as derived with drift tests.
Assign rule identifiers, scope, authority, preconditions and evidence obligations.
Represent verification operations as approved identifiers with typed parameters, not shell strings.
Mark optimizer-immutable proof/authority boundaries.
Add negative tests proving obligations survive optimization/editing.
acceptance_criteria: Obligations cannot be silently rewritten as recommendations.
Verification operations are allowlisted and typed.
Optimizer edits preserve proof boundaries.

assessment.note: Verified byte-identical duplicated prompts; RFC-style normative remediation only, no new executive authority proposed.
